canonical_J.object_keys: Unicode scalar lexicographic, not UTF16 code-unit sorting
canonical_J.strings: Escape U+007F and above to lowercase hex Unicode escapes; U+0000..001F use JSON short escapes where defined, otherwise Unicode escape. Quote/backslash escaped, slash unescaped. Supplementary scalars use surrogate-pair escapes. ASCII U+0020..007E otherwise literal.
canonical_J.numbers: integers only [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no -0 token, floats, exponents, NaN or Infinity
canonical_J.forbidden: duplicate keys, lone surrogates, nonstring keys, opaque/async values, trailing data
canonical_J.arrays: ordered unless exact recipe explicitly specifies sorting; reject duplicate semantic set members, never silently deduplicate
canonical_J.transport: Files/stdout exactly J(object)+one LF. No BOM, CRLF, extra whitespace or trailing bytes. LF never part of a digest preimage.

Htag_bytes: ASCII("ea-c21/1/")+ASCII(exact tag)+00+J(exact registry value); lowercase SHA256 hex of concatenation. No length prefix or LF. Tags selected ONLY by this registry.

state_row_sort: For each group rows use J(key) unsigned UTF8 byte lexicographic; unique keys. Cross-group order G1,G2,G3,G4,G5,G6,G7,G9. Hash stored decoded values, but verify physical payload bytes exactly equal J(payload) before hashing.
G8_rule: G8 key [sequence] plus body publication_sequence agree. Body hash chains predecessor. Do not put G8 new row/hash into its own nonG8 manifest.
root_rule: Verify descriptor/source artifact and all artifacts against out-of-band authorized RootSeal/root id and actual source/backend qualification, not just self-recomputed hashes. NumericProfile pending -> O5, no admitted world.
field_types: All preimage types are closed $defs in schemas/B0_CONTRACTS.schema.json; RawByteSequence/StrictJSONValue are encoding-domain primitives, not opaque product blobs.

source_checkpoint_schema_rule: G9 committed payload bytes remain committed even when physically absent; verified scratch reconstitution supplies precisely same preimage. See CHECKPOINT_CONTRACT; no hash waiver.
